from machine import Pin, SPI
import time


class MAX6675:
    def __init__(self, spi, cs):
        self.spi = spi
        self.cs = Pin(cs, Pin.OUT, value=1)

    def read(self):
        self.cs.value(0)
        b = self.spi.read(2)
        self.cs.value(1)
        raw = (b[0] << 8) | b[1]
        if raw & 0x4:
            raise OSError('thermocouple not connected')
        return (raw >> 3) * 0.25
